responsibility: NeXT Objective-C runtime backend for ABI 0/1 (module versions 6 and 7), used by the older Darwin/NeXT runtime model. It installs runtime hooks for legacy NeXT metadata layouts, class/category/protocol/string declarations, selector/class/protocol references, ivar access, super dispatch, message-send lowering including stret and non-nil fast paths, constant-string support, and generation of ABI-0/1 metadata/module records; it also implements the associated Objective-C exception lowering, including Darwin setjmp/longjmp exception support and the runtime/personality choices used by this older ABI.
